meta.revisionPolicy: Section 42 figures are provisional, then final; sectoral credit is provisional and revised the next month; NPAs and capital ratios are final on release. Seams disclosed, never joined: the 2019 sectoral classification, the July 2023 HDFC merger, the December 2025 reporting calendar.
meta.coverage: Business of scheduled banks by bank group, including regional rural banks and co-operative banks, every month (also report 991)
meta.note: RBI DBIE report 987 (data provider DP3), read from the local Data Bank mirror, as published. One display unit kept (ACTUALS). Final figures where published, else provisional. Amounts in ₹ crore. Left out as printed in the wrong unit (9 values, e.g. Nationalised banks, Borrowings on 1997-10-01; Regional rural banks, Inland Bills-Discounted on 2003-11-01; State co-operative banks, Borrowings on 2009-05-01).
